about_short_description.short_description: Outerbase is an interface to view, edit, and modify data and generate visual dashboards without having to write a single line of SQL.

product.name: EZQL
product.description: An AI-powered natural language interface that generates and refines SQL queries for instant data insights.

product.name: Tables
product.description: A spreadsheet-like table editor with enhanced features, customizable plugins, and embeddable capabilities for data navigation and editing.

product.name: Boards
product.description: A dashboard tool that enables users to create, customize, and embed visual data charts from multiple databases using AI assistance.

product.name: Data Catalog
product.description: A tool to define business terms, create relational diagrams, and add virtual relationships to database schemas for better data understanding.

product.name: Outerbase Studio
product.description: An open-source database GUI for managing and querying MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite databases locally or remotely.

product.name: Plugins
product.description: Extensible application-layer code modules that add custom functionality to databases, such as query modification, event handling, and authentication.
